subject: SIG initiation — hosting/residency and HIPAA scope clarification
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@medifact.com>
To: irene_choi@redwood.ai
Cc: security@medifact.com
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Security questionnaire kick-off and hosting question

Hi Irene —

Great to speak earlier. To kick off our security review internally we want to confirm which questionnaire path to take (SIG vs CAIQ vs a short custom form). A few details from our side:

- Medifact is US-headquartered and will process PHI for a subset of customers (covered under our BAA).
- Primary concern is data residency and where inference/processing occurs (we operate in us-west and eu-west).
- SOC 2 status — we usually prefer vendors with either completed SOC 2 or an active timeline. Can you confirm Redwood's current standing and expected SOC 2 timeline?

We can fill whatever prefill you send, but wanted your recommendation: SIG (full) or CAIQ-lite? Also please confirm who @Redwood will be our evidence owner for operational questions.

Would like to get a 30-min call this week to align on scope and timeline. Our security team (cc'd) will join.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Morales
Head of IT Security
Medifact Inc.
(elena.morales@medifact.com)

Attachments: Medifact_BAA_request.pdf
From: irene_choi@redwood.ai
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@medifact.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security questionnaire kick-off and hosting question

Hi Elena —

Thanks — that's helpful. Short answers up-front:

- Recommendation: start with the SIG (we can prefill many items). SIG gives a clearer evidence map for SOC 2 and hosting details; CAIQ is fine if you need a shorter, architecture-focused view.
- SOC 2: Redwood is in the process of finalizing Type II; audit period completed May 2026, report expected Q3 2026 (target mid-August). I can share a SOC 2 bridges/attestation note once finalized.
- HIPAA/BAA: Redwood supports BAAs and we have an established process — happy to review the PDF you attached.
- Data residency: we support pinned hosting to regions (US, EU). We need to confirm whether your PHI will remain in US-only or span EU — that determines evidence and controls mapping.

Questions for you before we schedule:
1) Will Medifact require inference to be pinned to US-only for PHI workloads?
2) Expected concurrent throughput / tokens for the initial integration (rough ballpark helps with dedicated vs hosted guidance).
3) Any third-party hosting (partner clouds) in scope?

Next steps I propose:
- I will send our SIG-prefill template (small workbook) for you to populate the basics.
- Kimberly (cc) will scope evidence asks and KMS questions.
- Can you share 30-min windows tomorrow or Thursday?

Thanks — I can coordinate the prefill and a short kickoff.

Best,
Irene Choi
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
(irene_choi@redwood.ai)

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@medifact.com>, irene_choi@redwood.ai
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2026 13:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security questionnaire kick-off and hosting question

Hi Elena — quick intro, I'm Kimberly (security eng at Redwood). A few clarifying items so we can size the evidence ask properly:

- SOC 2 specifics: per Irene, report expected Q3. For now we'll provide the interim controls summary and the audit engagement info.
- KMS/keys: do you require customer-managed keys (CMK) or is Redwood-managed KMS acceptable for your HIPAA scope? If CMK is required we have a documented onboarding flow and HSM/KMS integrations to discuss.
- PHI dataflow: please confirm whether PHI is sent to the API as raw text, or whether Medifact will tokenise/de-identify before sending. This changes our recommended hosting (pinned vs multi-region) and caching policy.
- Evidence owners: can you name a technical contact (network/infra owner) for evidence requests and access to any on-prem diagrams?

I attached our SIG-prefill-template.xlsx — fill the first two tabs (hosting + dataflow) and we'll drop a prioritized evidence list.

Suggested 30-min times from our side: Wed 06/30 09:00-11:00 PT or Thu 07/01 13:00-15:00 PT. Which works?

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
(kimberly_park@redwood.ai)

Attachments: SIG-prefill-template.xlsx
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@medifact.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, irene_choi@redwood.ai
Cc: security@medifact.com, jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2026 15:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security questionnaire kick-off and hosting question

Thanks Irene / Kimberly —

Answers:
- PHI handling: for initial integration we will send de-identified payloads, but we expect a production path where PHI may be submitted. So we need BAA + US-only residency for PHI workloads.
- Throughput: small start — ~50 concurrent requests, avg 1k tokens per request.
- Third-party hosting: no additional partners for inference — current plan is to use Redwood in us-west region.
- Technical contact: attaching our infra diagram and BAA request. Network owner: Mateo Ruiz (mateo.ruiz@medifact.com) — cc'd on security@medifact.com.

We can do the Wed 06/30 09:30 PT slot if you can make it — otherwise Thu 07/01 13:00 PT also OK. I'll ask our security lead to start filling the SIG-prefill.

jonas.weber@redwood.ai: thanks for joining — Jonas said he'll be our internal tech owner for the demo and can take the API/dataflow questions.

Best,
Elena
